nodes.label: One PostgreSQL database per environment
nodes.rationale: Spec 11 §2: one app, one database. Solid Queue, Solid Cache, Solid Cable and Active Storage metadata all live in the same PostgreSQL database rather than in separate stores, so the deployment stays two Docker Compose services with no Redis. Connection settings come from the environment (see .env.example).

nodes.label: Test checkout_timeout for the append-lock concurrency spec
nodes.rationale: The concurrency spec runs 50 appending threads against the pg_advisory_xact_lock append lock; the 60 second checkout timeout exists so those threads can wait for a pooled connection instead of failing the test for an unrelated reason.
